text: The one-inch quartz tube used for CVD is acetone-cleaned and dried via initial heating to 150 °C. [...] As the Ar fills the quartz tube, the pressure gauge reading will increase initially. After the quartz tube is filled, the pressure gauge reading stabilizes between 65 and 75 Torr. [...] Thus, once the pressure gauge reading stabilizes and the temperature reaches about 600 °C for MoO3, an Ar flow of 100–200 sccm is sufficient to cause the drift of sulfur to Mo.

source.title: Towards Low-Temperature CVD Synthesis and Characterization of Mono- or Few-Layer Molybdenum Disulfide
